name: Angsana Corfu Resort & Spa
positioning: Hillside resort above the Ionian Sea on Corfu, Banyan Group's first property in Europe, with an infinity pool, private beach and private pool villas
best_for: Couples and families wanting a private pool villa with sea views
Travelers who want a spa blending Asian rituals with local ingredients
Families looking for a kids club and a private beach

facts.text: The resort sits on a verdant hillside above the Ionian Sea.
Angsana Corfu is Banyan Group's first property in Europe.
The resort pairs Greek hospitality with Asian influences across its rooms, suites and villas.
Corfu Old Town, Achilleion Palace and the Temple of Artemis ruins are a few minutes' drive from the resort.
The resort is near Corfu International Airport.
Benitses Bay Seaview Grand Rooms have balcony views of the sea and Benitses Bay.
Villa guests have exclusive access to the V-Lounge.
A dedicated Eclectic Villa Living team curates experiences for villa guests.
Four of the spa treatment rooms have their own steam rooms and baths.
The spa offers a Rain Mist massage inspired by Thai waterfall treatments.
Rangers' Club is the kids club for ages 4 to 11, with its own swimming pool, sandbox and games.
Restaurants serve Greek and Corfiot specialities alongside North Asian cuisine, sushi and international dishes.

highlights.text: The infinity pool blends with the sea, creating the illusion of swimming to the horizon.
Each Ionian pool villa has its own private pool and expansive outdoor terrace.
Spa treatments fuse Asian rituals with local organic ingredients, some grown in the hotel's rooftop garden.
The resort has a private beach, Emerald Beach.
The resort offers private luxury yacht tours around Corfu.

considerations.text: All outdoor food and drink outlets are subject to weather conditions.
During certain periods the villa guests' breakfast area and in-house experiences may not be available.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires flight connections.
